title: Two-scale Kakeya upper Minkowski lower bound
summary: We prove that every bounded Kakeya set in Rⁿ, n ≥ 4, has upper Minkowski dimension at least 0.597n. Here a Kakeya set contains a unit line segment in every direction. This improves the asymptotic coefficient c_KT = 1/α = 0.596968283237… in the Katz–Tao bound 1 + c_KT(n−1), where α is the unique root of α³−4α+2 = 0 in (1,2). The proof combines arithmetic estimates for line segments with geometric estimates for tubes at two different widths.

formalizes.title: New Kakeya estimates using Gromov's algebraic lemma

review.reason: Proves a lower bound on upper Minkowski dimension of bounded Kakeya sets in higher dimensions.
